title: malus sphaerocarpa
intro: Malus sphaerocarpa, commonly known as the Chinese crabapple, is a species of flowering plant in the family Rosaceae. This plant is known for its potential health benefits, including reducing inflammation and improving cardiovascular health, due to its ability to lower cholesterol levels and blood pressure. The therapeutic actions of Malus sphaerocarpa include antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and cardio-protective effects, which are attributed to its bioactive constituents such as flavonoids, phenolic acids, and triterpenoids. The bioactive constituents of Malus sphaerocarpa have been shown to exhibit various pharmacological activities, including free radical scavenging and anti-atherogenic properties.
